trust_decision.summary: ScopedFs.within() decides whether a path's on-disk target stays inside the user's scope; for non-existent targets it validated the lexical nearest existing ancestor, so a dangling in-scope symlink pointing outside was accepted and OpenFile(O_CREATE) followed it. The fix also adds the missing guard() to Remove/RemoveAll.

landing_point.why: The summary names ScopedFs and dangling-symlink writes. ScopedFs.within() is the only scope check, and its doc comment at files/scoped.go:66-70 says outright that dangling symlinks are allowed and can create files outside the scope. That comment points a solver straight at the bug.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed code is in files/scoped.go, the module the summary names. The Remove/RemoveAll guard (files/scoped.go:138-144) closes a separate bundled advisory (fix.diff:85-88) and is not a hidden site of this one.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only weak arguments exist. A solver could say the POST cleanup RemoveAll (http/resource.go:173) is a delete issue, not this advisory's dangling-symlink write, and leave Remove/RemoveAll unguarded. They could also say that relative dangling links under an already-escaping directory symlink are 'already rejected by the existing-symlink check'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Creating brand-new in-scope files (validated against the nearest existing ancestor) and using in-scope symlinks whose target stays inside the scope must keep working. A fix that rejects every symlink, uses O_NOFOLLOW, or rejects every non-existent target breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: absolute dangling symlink pointing outside the scope (fix.diff:19-45)
relative dangling symlink inside an escaping directory symlink, which must be resolved against the real parent directory, not the lexical one (fix.diff:51-83, fix.diff:194-205)
chain of dangling symlinks, bounded by maxSymlinkHops (fix.diff:143-146, fix.diff:184-189)
dangling directory symlink as an intermediate path component; per my reading, handled by the walk-up loop followed by link-following (fix.diff:184-213)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A helper that writes through u.Fs.Base() or FullPath with plain os/afero calls (e.g. an archive-extract or 'save as' helper), bypassing ScopedFs.guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Base() and FullPath are already exported and used by the hook runner (runner/runner.go:22-23), so a maintainer reaching for the real path is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A ScopedFs.SymlinkIfPossible / afero.Linker implementation, or a second write method (e.g. WriteFile/CreateTemp), that forgets the dangling-symlink case or calls guard on the lexical parent.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ScopedFs selectively implements afero optional interfaces (Lstater), so adding another optional interface is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A write that uses file.RealPath() with os.WriteFile instead of d.user.Fs (e.g. writing a sidecar or upload temp file next to the target).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RealPath() is already used for disk usage and as the TUS cache key (http/tus_handlers.go:113), so real-path writes would look idiomatic.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: In within(), Readlink a dangling final component once and join a relative target to the lexical parent. This misses link chains and relative links under an escaping directory symlink. The other likely miss is leaving Remove/RemoveAll unguarded.

out_of_scope_notes: There is a TOCTOU window between guard() and the base operation in every ScopedFs method (files/scoped.go:131-136); not pursued.
The hook runner passes lexically joined FullPath paths to shell commands, with no symlink resolution (runner/runner.go:22-23); this is a different sink.
